identification: Tray of seven Australian petroliana tins, c.1940s-1960s: Mobilgrease 5 lb tin (Vacuum Oil Company, Pegasus), Mobiloil Pegasus 1 imperial quart tin (Vacuum Oil Company), Castrol Anti-Freeze can (teal, rectangular, approx gallon), Esso Petrol-Oil Mixing Can (lawn mowers, outboard motors, motor scooters; rectangular gallon style), Shell Specialised Lubricants rectangular can (approx gallon), Wakefield Castrol motor oil gallon (green), Texaco Thuban quart-size green tin with red star. Photos show them in better visual condition than the cloud scan said: labels mostly legible, some flaking/spotting, Shell has a dent/hole mark, Esso label faded. Estimate 30-50, current bid $15.
